# Еда (Rambler)

> > A Russian culinary platform featuring traditional recipes, cooking master classes, and food preparation techniques from various cuisines including Russian, Moldavian, and international dishes.

Еда.Rambler.ru provides step-by-step cooking guides, recipe collections, and culinary expertise from professional chefs like Роман Лошманов, Константин Борисов, and home cooking experts. The site covers everything from classic Russian desserts like sharlotka to specialized techniques such as dry-aging meat and traditional Moldavian cuisine.

## Key Topics

- Russian cuisine
- Sharlotka (apple pie)
- Moldavian cuisine
- Mamalyga (cornmeal dish)
- Traditional recipes
- Master classes
- Home cooking
- Step-by-step guides
- Роман Лошманов
- Константин Борисов
- Classic desserts
- Food preservation
- Meat preparation
- Bryndza cheese
- Russian baking

## Cooking Master Classes & Techniques

- [Как почистить селедку](https://eda.rambler.ru/media/master-klass/kak-pochistit-seledku): Herring cleaning technique master class by Lara Katsova
- [Как состарить мясо в холодильнике](https://eda.rambler.ru/media/vsjudu-zhizn/kak-sostarit-myaso-v-holodilnike): DIY dry-aging beef guide by Roman Loshmanov and Ivan Piganov
- [Идеальный куриный шницель](https://eda.rambler.ru/media/master-klass/idealnyy-kurinyy-shnicel): Chicken schnitzel master class by chef Konstantin Borisov (Dizengof 99)

## Traditional Russian Recipes

- [Классическая шарлотка с яблоками](https://eda.rambler.ru/media/master-klass/klassicheskaya-sharlotka-s-yablokami): Step-by-step apple sharlotka recipe by Lyudmila Salnikova
- [Как замариновать огурцы с кетчупом на зиму](https://eda.rambler.ru/media/master-klass/kak-zamarinovat-ogurcy-s-ketchupom-na-zimu): Winter cucumber preserves with ketchup by Marina Shakleina

## Regional & International Cuisines

- [Мамалыга по-молдавски](https://eda.rambler.ru/recepty/osnovnye-blyuda/mamaliga-po-moldavski-16858): Moldavian mamalyga cornmeal recipe by Kim Cherotov with photos
